note: Lamb County TX has no county zoning power (Texas counties generally lack zoning authority under Ch. 231 except 11 named counties). The only city zoning found is Littlefield: an official Zoning Ordinance Map PDF and a 'Public Interactive Map' whose underlying queryable service I could not locate or verify. Olton, Amherst and Sudan show no zoning publication. ArcGIS search for Lamb zoning returned only the LambCAD parcel/boundary service (no zoning layer).
